correctness.rationale: The proof enumerates all idempotents by fixed image; zero-side images force constant maps, and the four positive-image cases are exhaustive. For fixed images, the allowed images of every remaining vertex follow from adjacency to all fixed vertices opposite its source side; every listed assignment satisfies the edge-collapse condition. Subtraction of the pair of ordinary transformation idempotent counts gives the exact side-crossing count. The maximum of (N-t)log t and a positive-summand lower bound establish log I_m and log S_m, and hence the announced logarithmic probability. A standalone exhaustive verifier independently checks all total maps and rank counts for nine graph sizes, but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full image-rank distribution of idempotents is a natural structural enumerative invariant of an important graph transformation monoid. The four fixed-image regimes isolate exactly the excess caused by collapsing graph edges, while the balanced limiting theorem gives a nontrivial superexponential side-rigidity rate. This is an infinite family classification and an interpretable quantitative phenomenon rather than a parameter substitution or an isolated small table.
